newsitem.title: FRANCE: Alcatel wins $220 mln Intelsat contract.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel wins $220 mln Intelsat contract.

text.p: Alcatel Telecom said on Wednesday its Alcatel Espace unit won a contract worth more than $220 million to build high-powered satellites for the International Telecommunications Satellite Organisation, INTELSAT.

A spokeswoman said Alcatel, as a subcontractor, had about a 37 percent share of an INTELSAT contract with a programme value of more than $600 million awarded to primary contractor Space Systems/Loral, a unit of Loral Space and Communications Ltd.
Under the contract, which Loral announced last week, Loral will build and deliver two INTELSAT IX satellites for launch in the year 2000.
The contract, which also has options for additional satellites, gives the Alcatel unit responsibility for producing the satellites' communication repeater modules.
The work will be carried out at its plant in Toulouse, southern France, in less than 28 months, Alcatel said.
Space activities at Alcatel Telecom, a division of Alcatel Alsthom, represented a turnover of nearly 3.6 billion francs in 1996.
